[SWS_CM_00802] Behavior of
ara::com
when unsubscribing from a trigger
⌈
After calling
Unsubscribe()
by
ara::com
at the proxy side, there shall be no active
subscription to the trigger and therefore no trigger shall be delivered to the application
(i.e. no
TriggerReceiveHandler
shall be called). Calling
Unsubscribe()
shall
set to zero the counter of received triggers returned by
GetNewTriggers()
.
⌋
7.5.18 Receive trigger
For the trigger data access C++ API reference, see chapter 8.3.7.1.2.1.
